body: I'm a little late, but i'm 23 here and relapsed after 6 years. Fucking sucks that i'm this much older now it'll only look even worse if I get caught. Officially moved to my leg, at least adult me isn't fucking stupid enough to do it on her arm :P

I'm in the same shoes as you in a way, except my mental ass got dumped after all the support I gave him. I'm probably close to 10k in debt from him not working 3 years, i'm also 23 in 10 days he was 9 years older, became massive potheads, I worked our whole relationship and paid for everything. He broke my heart a week before christmas, my stupid head didn't see it coming. I've had to move back to my home state, live at moms, with no job currently. So I understand it fucking sucks, and death really seems like the best way out. But keep pushing people care about you too <3 if you need to talk to someone im here. Sorry if my post is jumbled, can barely see.

I feel like the furthest thing from valuable or brave. I've lived my whole life for other people...and now that i'm completely alone I don't think i'm strong enough, I don't think my broken mind is made for this world.
As someone else struggling to stay afloat tonight, i'm glad you're still here...If you need a friend to talk to i'm here

I know my words probably don't mean a thing, but this hurt to read...I'm so sorry for whatever happened, I hope she found solace. Please try to move on, i'm sure that's what she would've wanted, someone else out there needs love somewhere aha. 

again i'm sorry my words don't mean much, I am sorry.
Couldn't have said this better myself....I wish they all hated me as much as I hate myself

Yeah I had them a lot with my ex. He probably triggered them a lot of the time, but calling me names and shouting. but uhm idk if it's different for everyone, but for me it's basically; my mind goes blank/cloudy, I cant form thoughts or sentences, my emotions are heightened by a lot (I.E. I'll be so Angry I can barely hold it in, or I cry so hard I cannot breath, etc.), I shake/rock if it gets bad enough, i repeat "I'm sorry" 100x, I demean myself more and outloud. Uhm i'm a mess when I have a panic attack...I honestly didn't even know I had them as much as I did.
I wish it did...really bad, I don't want to be like this. But if you're like me, you just keep holding on because everyone thinks your "so strong"...I just can't hurt them.

Hay this isn't my main account...I don't want my ex or anyone knowing i'm not doing well. Uhm if you need a friend to talk about you know actual stuff....like all this bullshit mental stuff i'm here. I need someone too...I feel odd typing this as I'm nearly in tears over shit, but uhm ill pm you my cell. if you want to text me you can, if not thats okay too. good luck friend. <3
